languages.selection: ?lang= wins, then an explicit /en/ path, then the scoped pwa_lang cookie. Language links preserve the current page and its shop filters.
languages.content: One JSON-valued admin_settings row per bilingual editorial text; domain tables carry explicit _en columns. text_<key>_<lang> rows override any dictionary key at render time.

design.thesis: The business is called Fait Main — handmade — so the single repeated graphic device is a hand-drawn line: a soft sage wave that opens every section, underlines the active nav item and separates ideas. Everything else stays quiet so the owner's own photography and words carry the page.
design.paletteRationale: The two source brand colours were kept exactly (#E6BEBE powder rose, #91AB78 sage) and given a hierarchy the old site lacked: anthracite for all text, sage for wellness and every primary action, powder rose reserved for gifting, packages and offers. The old site's default blue links (rgb(0,0,238)) are gone.
design.type: Fraunces 400/500/600 for display, Figtree 400/500/600/700 for body and UI. Replaces the source's Arial + Sora mix.
design.structure: 1180px container, generous vertical rhythm, uniform card system with one image ratio per card type (products 1:1, collections and articles 4:3), pill buttons, 52px minimum control height.
deviations: Treatment cards are typographic rather than photographic. The imported per-treatment thumbnails are 84–309px and could not be reliably matched to individual treatments, so attaching them would have risked showing the wrong photo for a paid service.
Products without a positively identified photo show a quiet sage sprig mark instead of a stretched or borrowed image.
The mobile drawer opens from the left. A fixed panel parked off-canvas to the right counts toward document scroll width in Chrome and made every page scroll sideways on a phone.

pages.job: Carry the promise of softness, then route to booking and to the shop
The 11 massage treatments with duration and rate
Facials, lashes and brows, plus the full waxing menu
Maderotherapy, wraps, back care and anti-cellulite
The five multi-session packages and the combined wellness treatments
Browse 28 products by collection or search
One product, its options and add-to-cart
Review the basket and place an order
One order, its totals and PayPal payment
Annie Bouchard, the team's approach and qualifications
Address, phone, hours and the contact form
Hand off to the booking system with the full service catalogue visible
The owner-approved privacy notice and terms of sale

redirects.note: Every canonical page also answers on its bare (no trailing slash) form with a 301. The router runs with Express strict routing precisely so those redirects cannot match the canonical URL and loop.

tables.seeding: 57 treatments, 5 packages, 28 products, 3 articles and 7 opening-hour rows, all transcribed from the authorized import. No fabricated customer, order, payment or review records. The platform _seed_version sentinel prevents reseeding over edited content.

booking.implementation: Every Réserver button points at the booking_url admin setting, which is seeded with the source site's own booking page.
booking.why: The brief asked to preserve the existing booking link. The business runs a real multi-practitioner schedule, so no native booking was built — a second scheduler would risk double-booking.
booking.gate: booking_url_verified. Until Annie confirms it, the booking page says the link is to be confirmed.
booking.risk: The seeded URL lives on the old domain. It must be repointed before that domain is retired.

shop.cart: Held in the visitor's own browser (localStorage, guarded for private windows). It carries only slug, chosen option and quantity.
shop.pricing: Every amount is computed server-side in lib/orders.js from the products table. The browser never sends a price. Options are validated against the product's own list, and an out-of-stock or unpublished item fails the whole basket.
shop.taxes: GST and QST are read from admin_settings in basis points (500 / 998 by default) and applied to the pre-tax amount including shipping, which is how QST has worked since 2013.
shop.fulfilment: Pickup is always offered and always free. Shipping only appears once the owner has both enabled it and entered a rate — no delivery price is ever invented.
shop.idempotency: A per-basket request key plus a UNIQUE(user_id, request_key) constraint makes a double submit return the original order instead of creating a second one.

payments.provider: PayPal Orders v2, Payments v2 and the official JavaScript SDK v6
checks: Fixed CAD amount read from the database, never from the browser
Merchant id, order id and CAPTURE intent
Capture currency, gross amount and final_capture
Credential and environment bound to the row at order creation
Stable create and capture request ids so a retry cannot double-charge
payments.recovery: Customer-triggered sync, an owner reconcile button, and a five-minute GET-only background reconciliation. An order whose creation attempt is older than five hours stops for manual review instead of risking a second order.
payments.webhooks: Not used. No unsigned webhook endpoint exists.
payments.setupBoundary: Credentials being present does not mean anything was verified. payments_enabled, payment_terms_approved and live_actions_enabled all start off, and preview mode always suppresses charging.

capabilities: A launch checklist of everything still switched off
admin.security: Every admin page and API checks services.admin.isAdmin. Writes require a same-origin request and an explicit X-Requested-With header. Orders cannot be created by hand, amounts are read-only, and an order that has reached PayPal cannot be deleted.

gates.principle: Anything that speaks for the business or spends money is off until the owner turns it on from Réglages.

pwa.push: Only after a real interaction: eight seconds after the first scroll or pointer event, and only when notifications are enabled. The footer also carries an explicit button.
pwa.private: Cart, order and admin responses are no-store. No payment result is ever inferred offline.

business.publicationRule: Contact settings are seeded from services.config business fields, not from the account-owner literals, and stay hidden until the owner confirms they belong to the practice.

assets.hosting: Every reused asset URL is the platform's own R2 copy. The previous host is never hotlinked.
assets.inspected: All 23 reused assets were opened and looked at before being placed.

reused.what: Authentic treatment photograph from the source home page
The two portraits the source itself labels Annie Bouchard, each kept in the context the source used it in
The source's own massage, skin-care, nail, body and team banners
The real photograph of the rental room
The four shop category still lifes
Only 5 of 28: the Camphre+Cachemire candle, the Boho hair towel, the lavender tea, Palo Santo and the Boho headband
The three journal images, each matched to its article by the source's own alt text

assets.excludedAfterInspection: The per-treatment thumbnails (84×84 to 309×207) were left out. They are too small to publish at card size and their order in the import did not reliably identify which treatment each one belongs to — the first two shop thumbnails, for example, are both the same candle.

contentDecisions: All 57 treatments, their durations and their rates are transcribed exactly as the source stated them on 2026-09-17.

The four shop collections and their wording come from the source. Which product sits in which collection is a merchandising judgement made here, not a fact from the source, and is fully editable in the admin.
Article bodies were not importable, so each article carries the real title, date, image and opening lines, and the body is left empty for the owner to paste in.

gaps: Free-shipping threshold conflicts in the source: the shop page says 75 $ (twice), the about page says 49 $. 75 $ is seeded. Annie must confirm.
No shipping rate exists anywhere in the source, so shipping is disabled and only pickup is offered until she enters one.
23 of 28 products have no photograph yet.
No treatment has a publishable photograph yet — high-resolution images would let the treatment cards carry imagery.
Article bodies are empty: only titles, dates, images and opening lines were importable.
booking_url still points at the old domain's booking page and must be repointed before that domain is retired.
GST and QST registration numbers are empty.
Team members other than Annie are described but never named in the source.
The import was capped at 20 pages and 100 images, and long pages with lazy-loaded sections may be incomplete.
Rates, opening hours and the privacy notice are imported, not verified: each stays behind its own gate until the owner confirms it.

Zero horizontal overflow at 390px across 12 pages. Live email and PayPal operations have NOT been executed — they stay behind their gates until the owner turns them on.
